item.title: The Libyan Henna You’ve Never Heard Of: Misrata’s “Fish Net” Henna Tradition
item.description: In Misrata, Libya, henna is not painted onto the skin. It is tied. Using a wool rope instead of a cone, brides are wrapped in a fishnet pattern that reflects the city’s deep connection to the sea, marriage, and women’s oral traditions passed down for centuries.
